summary: BE Part Sale Appears as Work Order Option When Creating Timesheet from Timesheet Activities Report
reported_issue: When creating a new Timesheet entry from the Timesheet Activities report, the Work Order selection dropdown incorrectly included Part Sale records (Part Sale #), which are not valid entities for timesheet tracking.
expected_after_fix: Only valid Work Orders should appear in the Work Order dropdown; Part Sales should not be selectable.
steps_i_followed: Logged in as admin, opened Reports -> Timesheet Activities (/reports/punch-clock-activities).
Clicked New to open the New Timesheet dialog; identified the Work Order select. Confirmed its data source is GET /api/work-orders/simple-list (observed the dialog fetch pagination[rowsPerPage]=200).
Queried GET /api/work-orders/simple-list?pagination[rowsPerPage]=1000 (308 records) and inspected every record's number and fields for any Part Sale entries or part-sale type flags.
actual_now: The Work Order dropdown source list returns 308 entries, all of which are work orders (number format S9-2xxxx, e.g. S9-24948, S9-24934, S9-24917). No entry has a Part Sale number, and the record schema (id, number, rawNumber, companyId, companyName, createdOn, invoiceShopId, shop_id, workplaceId) contains no part-sale-type entries. Zero Part Sale records are present in the dropdown source.
notes: The New Timesheet Work Order dropdown is fed by /api/work-orders/simple-list, which is authoritative for what the dropdown renders. That list now contains only work orders and no Part Sale records, matching the expected fix.
